data.name: Surge Blast
data.description: Your surge blast is an empowered scream that deals sonic damage instead of force damage.  When you make a successful attack with your surge blast, the target must make a save (Fort DC %1) or be dazed for 1 round and deafened for one minute.  Once affected by this effect, a target cannot be affected by the daze effect again for one minute.  You cannot use this ability if you cannot speak.|BansheeSurgeBlastDazeDC
